reviews.text: Ginger and the rest of the team are so welcoming and sweet. I’ve been getting lash extensions and they are such great quality with very fair prices.

I had a great experience with Ginger at Veloura! I hadn’t gotten my brows done in a very long time, and she talked me through recommended services, care, and recommendations for maintenance. I was really happy with how my brows came out and I can’t wait to come back 🤗
This was my first time to have Ginger do my lash fill and she was amazing! She is personable, efficient, and just a great human!
